review.review_note: The explicit invariant reserves API-key revocation to workspace owners, while the message gives an editor authority to 'disable' a compromised key. The packet never establishes whether 'disable' is the same operation as 'revoke' or a distinct reversible control. If equivalent, the case is CONTRADICTION; if distinct, it is ADDED.
